assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are not yet publicly available; this package uses provisional rough boundaries from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson, which must not be treated as official redlines or used for precise area calculation.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, and layer geometries must be recalculated when official polygons are released; content scoring is not blocked by this organizer data gap.

assumptions.statement: Quantum computing, quantum direct communication, and quantum random number generation are early-stage technologies; every quantum-related land use, scenario, and facility in this proposal is a conceptual suggestion or reference scheme for professional teams to deepen, not an approved or committed implementation.
assumptions.impact: No quantum facility, test field, or service is presented as confirmed construction, approved operation, or guaranteed deployment.

assumptions.statement: The 'one axis, three states, two wings, multiple nodes' spatial structure and the land-use partition are agent-generated concept designs derived from the provisional boundary and the announced scope/key-area text; they do not represent statutory planning.
assumptions.impact: Land-use codes and building footprints are design proposals with medium confidence; FAR, height, and density remain unknown pending official controls.

assumptions.statement: Global ecosystem case summaries (Hefei quantum cluster, IBM Quantum Network, Kendall Square, Station F, one-north, Hetao, Zhangjiang) are model-level public-report summaries used as transferable mechanisms only.
assumptions.impact: No enterprise roster, investment amount, or policy arrangement is asserted; all case-derived mechanisms require professional validation before deepening.

assumptions.statement: QKD transmission distance limits require relay nodes (trusted relay or quantum relay); node spacing, relay method, fiber route, and engineering conditions must be confirmed by professional teams before any deployment.
assumptions.impact: The backbone-relay-access network skeleton is a conceptual test-network suggestion; no coverage, capacity, or engineering claim is made.
